description: List every measure Blockchain Academics Stats ranks by: its id, its tab, what it counts, its unit, which rows it covers and whether it is measured yet, with how many rows each tab holds today (8 centralised exchanges and the Hyperliquid vaults). Takes no arguments. A measure marked not_measured_yet has no values yet, so its ranking lists the rows with no rank. Works without an API key.
name: list_stats_measures
